_doc: THE PLAYER-TIER SURFACE REGISTRY (issue #737, part of the #660 'all UI into kits' epic). The single manifest that enumerates every player-tier surface FAMILY and the kit / shared component each MUST compose. It is the 'always-updated guarantee' the epic asks for: the per-kit convention gates (test_f3_window_ratchet.py for windows, test_og_gadget_kit.py for rail gadgets, test_on_notice_kit.py for above-composer notices, test_0753_sheet_kit.py for sheets, test_0773_element_kit.py for atomic controls) each pin ONE family; this registry unifies them into one index AND adds a drift guard so a NEW surface kit cannot be added without registering it here (mirroring how the F-3 ratchet refuses a new hand-rolled window). Enforced by tests/test_737_surface_registry.py. Purely additive: it does not change any runtime surface; it is a test-time coverage/drift contract.

_kinds.kit: A composite surface kit exposed through a `window.Orwell<Name>Kit` composition seam (a create()-style factory). These are the families the drift guard keeps in lock-step: the set of `window.Orwell*Kit = {` definitions across static/js MUST equal the set of `kind:'kit'` entries here.
_kinds.component: A shared render-only surface component exposed through a `window.Orwell<Name>` global (one canonical implementation reused by several surfaces — e.g. the monogram tile, the account avatar).
_kinds.css: A kit whose single source of truth is a CSS class family / region in style.css (the atomic-control / element kit), with an optional demo driver.

_drift_guard: The ratchet (test_drift_guard_kit_seams_stay_in_sync): every `window.Orwell*Kit = {` object defined anywhere in frontend/static/js/*.js MUST be registered here as a kind:'kit' family, and every registered kit seam MUST be defined in its declared file. A new kit (e.g. a stray orwellFoo.js exporting window.OrwellFooKit) that is not registered fails the gate; a registered kit whose definition disappears or moves file fails too. Never silent.

families.family: Floating windows / modals / popovers (the window band)
families.note: The Lane-F kit. Cast / Finale / Retrospective / New-Season / headshot dialogs compose it; docked windows re-home into the gadget rail. The F-3 ratchet already pins that no new window hand-rolls chrome.

families.family: Control-room rail gadgets (the sidebar gadget cards)
families.note: The #640 sibling of the window kit. Status / Deals / Cast-pin / Nightfall / Presence gadgets compose it. Order/side/collapse sync through the 0064 layout store.

families.family: Above-composer affordance zone (game guide, narrator-proposed decisions, system notices, Continue prompt, top banner, toasts)
families.note: The #642 kit. The decision card is its charter member (kind 'decision'); the premiere guide, the OOC chat hint, the engine-status banner (top-banner placement), and the unified toast system (#951) all compose it.

families.family: iOS-style bottom sheets (casting sheet, anchored decision action-sheet, drawer)
families.note: The #753 kit (UISheetPresentationController in CSS/JS): detents, opaque-up, grabber gestures, the a11y trio. Composes the shared --ow-glass-* material so it paints one visual language with the other kits.

families.family: Atomic HIG controls (button / field / check / radio / switch / select / slider)
families.note: The #773 element kit — the CSS `── ELEMENT KIT ──` region in style.css is the single source for the atomic primitives every surface composes. orwellElements.js is a DEMO-ONLY driver (not shipped in the app shell).

families.family: Houseguest portrait / monogram tile + role badges (cast window, rail chips, decision cards)
families.note: The M2-2 designed monogram system — ONE render-only, Vault-free component reused wherever a face renders, so a portrait-less roster reads as designed cast cards, never flat letter-rectangles.

families.family: Account avatar circle (sidebar user bar, Settings account card)
families.note: The G27 account avatar — paints the finalized casting headshot into the profile circle(s); default is the Apple-style monochrome person glyph. Fail-open, reads only the user's own /api/orwell/avatar.

The #658 kit (part of the #660 epic). Sibling to OrwellWindow/OrwellGadget/OrwellNotice. Every Settings section composes it — create() a fresh card, or upgrade() an existing .admin-card in place (keeping .admin-card so peek / empty-tab / .closest still work). First adoption: the Appearance tab (initAppearance -> upgradePanel).
